title: APIs & Keys
motto: Every AI API works the same way: send a request, get a response. The details change, the pattern doesn't.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Every AI API works the same way: send a request, get a response. The details change, the pattern doesn't.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Starting from Phase 11, you'll call LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google). In Phase 13-16 you'll build agents that use these APIs in loops. You need to know how API keys work, how to store them safely, and how to make your first API call.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Store API keys in environment variables — never commit secrets.

steps.title: Implement keys
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.
